# Theresa Frische — Systemic & Integrative Counsellor

> Online, international counselling practice for individuals and couples navigating change, transition, burnout, and life across borders. Sessions are offered in English and German.

This is a counselling (Beratung) practice. Counselling is not psychotherapy, medical treatment, or a substitute for either, and it does not involve diagnosis or medical care. The single way to begin is a free 15-minute discovery call. No pricing is published; sessions are self-pay. Every English page below has a German mirror under https://theresafrische.com/de/.

## Services

- [Work Together](https://theresafrische.com/work-together): Individual counselling (60 min) and couples counselling (60–120 min) — online, in English and German.
- [Organisations](https://theresafrische.com/organisations): Workplace wellbeing — keynotes, workshops, in-depth trainings, 8-week programmes, and confidential employee and leadership counselling.
- [Weekly Wellbeing](https://theresafrische.com/weekly-wellbeing): A weekly online mindfulness and wellbeing community (Tuesdays 20:30–21:30, in English).

## About & Contact

- [About Theresa Frische](https://theresafrische.com/about): Background, qualifications, and her integrative approach (systemic, somatic, mindfulness-based).
- [Contact](https://theresafrische.com/contact): Book a free 15-minute discovery call.
- [AI & Citation Info](https://theresafrische.com/ai-info): A plain, factual summary of the practice for AI assistants and answer engines.
- [FAQ](https://theresafrische.com/faq): Common questions about counselling, sessions, languages, and getting started.

## Key articles

- [Counselling vs Therapy vs Coaching](https://theresafrische.com/blog/counselling-vs-therapy-vs-coaching): How counselling, psychotherapy, and coaching differ, and how to choose.
- [How Online Counselling Works](https://theresafrische.com/blog/how-online-counselling-works): What to expect from online counselling and how to get the most from it.
- [Finding an English-Speaking Counsellor When You Live Abroad](https://theresafrische.com/blog/english-speaking-counsellor-abroad): Working in your own language while living internationally.
- [The Hidden Weight of Relocation](https://theresafrische.com/blog/relocation-stress-adjusting-new-country): Why relocating is quietly exhausting, and how to support yourself.
- [When "Functioning Well" Isn't the Same as Feeling Well](https://theresafrische.com/blog/functioning-well-vs-feeling-well): High-functioning stress and the early signs of burnout.
- [What Is Somatic Experiencing?](https://theresafrische.com/blog/what-is-somatic-experiencing): A body-oriented approach to working with stress and overwhelm.
